collection.title: National Security Council (NSC) Institutional Files (IF) Transition Files
collection.methodology: Every file unit was enumerated from the complete NARA Catalog series hierarchy. Working chronology uses dated covering memoranda, compilation cover dates, folder-title months, and an explicit Winter 1989 label; normalized first-of-month values are sorting aids, not invented day dates. NARA extracted text supplies high-level and economic-policy review signals for every online PDF. Routing reflects manual review of every title, full OCR transcript, opening provenance marker, withdrawal-sheet description, and duplicate transition-book copy. Marker status requires the opening OCR segment to name the record group, office, series, subseries, and folder.

fileUnits.title: Reagan-Bush Transition Briefing Book: National Security Activities
fileUnits.archivalLocator: George H.W. Bush Library, Bush Presidential Records, National Security Council, H-Files, IF Transition Files, OA/ID 99015–003, Reagan-Bush Transition Briefing Book: National Security Activities.
fileUnits.provenanceStem: Source: George H.W. Bush Library, Bush Presidential Records, National Security Council, H-Files, IF Transition Files, OA/ID 99015–003, Reagan-Bush Transition Briefing Book: National Security Activities.
fileUnits.reviewFocus: The transition briefing book contains a four-page paper on the Economic Summits, a two-page chronology of preparations for the 1988 Toronto Summit, and a transition calendar extending into July 1989. The paper recommends early decisions about organization and U.S. objectives for the Paris Summit and records State-Treasury friction in the Sherpa process.
fileUnits.reviewKeyExtent: released copies of the 4-page Economic Summits paper and 2-page Toronto chronology are present; the master withdrawal sheet shows their former (b)(1) restrictions crossed out

fileUnits.title: Reagan-Bush Transition Briefing Book: NSC Policy Issues
fileUnits.archivalLocator: George H.W. Bush Library, Bush Presidential Records, National Security Council, H-Files, IF Transition Files, OA/ID 99015–005, Reagan-Bush Transition Briefing Book: NSC Policy Issues.
fileUnits.provenanceStem: Source: George H.W. Bush Library, Bush Presidential Records, National Security Council, H-Files, IF Transition Files, OA/ID 99015–005, Reagan-Bush Transition Briefing Book: NSC Policy Issues.
fileUnits.reviewFocus: The six-page International Economic Affairs Directorate paper is a compact transition agenda for the incoming administration. It covers Paris Summit organization, Trade Act authorities, the Uruguay Round, Japan rice and semiconductors, Section 232 petitions, the EC meat-hormone dispute and 1992 single market, East-West credits, middle-income and African debt, IMF quotas, energy, and technology competitiveness.
fileUnits.reviewKeyExtent: the released 6-page International Economic Affairs Directorate paper is present and its former (b)(1) entry is crossed out; a separate 5-page International Programs/Technology Affairs paper remains represented by a (b)(1) withdrawal sheet

fileUnits.title: Reagan-Bush Transition Briefing Book: Background on NSC Organization and Administration
fileUnits.chapter: Transition Economies and International Economic Strategy
fileUnits.archivalLocator: George H.W. Bush Library, Bush Presidential Records, National Security Council, H-Files, IF Transition Files, OA/ID 99015–001, Reagan-Bush Transition Briefing Book: Background on NSC Organization and Administration.
fileUnits.provenanceStem: Source: George H.W. Bush Library, Bush Presidential Records, National Security Council, H-Files, IF Transition Files, OA/ID 99015–001, Reagan-Bush Transition Briefing Book: Background on NSC Organization and Administration.
fileUnits.reviewFocus: The covering memorandum and briefing book define the outgoing NSC's international-economic portfolio, including trade, debt, multilateral development banks, energy, the Paris Summit, East-West economic relations, and technology-transfer responsibilities. Use this as institutional and authorship context; the more substantive policy-issues briefing in NAID 470760859 should normally control documentary selection.
fileUnits.reviewKeyExtent: the released November 9 covering memorandum and directorate descriptions are present; two unrelated attachments totaling 11 pages remain identified on the withdrawal sheet

fileUnits.chapter: Transition Economies and International Economic Strategy
fileUnits.archivalLocator: George H.W. Bush Library, Bush Presidential Records, National Security Council, H-Files, IF Transition Files, OA/ID 99016–003, [NSC: Reagan-Bush Transition Background Materials—Volume I—January 1989] [3].

fileUnits.reviewFocus: Stephen P. Farrar's one-page memorandum requests retention for Scowcroft's incoming staff of the International Economic Affairs Directorate files on agriculture, Brazil, budget, debt, the EC, energy, OECD, Panama, the Paris Summit, sanctions, the Soviet Union, trade, and Western lending to the Soviet bloc. It is primarily a compiler discovery and provenance lead, not a substitute for the retained substantive files.
fileUnits.reviewKeyExtent: the released January 6 Farrar memorandum is 1 page; duplicate copies also appear in NAIDs 470760865 and 470760868 and are not separately promoted
